claim: Apple's June-quarter revenue reached $109.4 billion in fiscal Q3 2026.
summary: Apple's fiscal Q3 2026 (June quarter) ends in June 2026 and would be reported in late July/early August 2026, after the model's knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04. No evidence is available to verify revenue of $109.4 billion for that period without tools.
